$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to this JSON Schema.

vaultRoot.description: Required absolute path to the one vault that this process may scan. The configured root and all scanned entries must pass runtime realpath and symlink checks.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for today and relative date expressions.

vaultName.description: Optional Obsidian vault name used only to construct obsidian://open URIs. If omitted, URI generation is disabled.

statuses.description: Mapping from one-character Markdown checkbox symbols to normalized status names and types. Runtime validation also requires unique symbols.

excludedDirectories.description: Vault-relative directory names or paths skipped during scans. Absolute paths and parent traversal are invalid.

maxFiles.description: Hard failure threshold for the number of filesystem entries considered in one scan.

maxFileBytes.description: Maximum size of one Markdown file. Oversized files are skipped with a warning.

maxTotalBytes.description: Hard failure threshold for total Markdown bytes read in one request.

maxReturnedTasks.description: Maximum task records returned. The scan still computes totalMatches and reports truncation.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 size of the serialized response. The response remains valid JSON and reports truncation.

maxAnyOfClauses.description: Maximum number of non-recursive OR clauses in one query.

maxSortFields.description: Maximum ordered sort keys in one query.

archive.description: Optional explicit enablement for archive-done write mode. Runtime validation rejects overlapping paths.

archiveRoot.description: Required vault-relative destination directory; no built-in default.

sourceRoots.description: Required vault-relative source directories; no built-in default.

minAgeDays.description: Minimum age of the matching root-task terminal date before archiving.

deleteEmptySourceNotes.description: Archive a complete source note and delete it when no checklist task remains.
